name: std::shared_ptr<T>::operator bool
intro: Checks if *this stores a non-null pointer, i.e. whether get() != nullptr.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if *this stores a pointer, false otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: An empty shared_ptr (where use_count() == 0) may store a non-null pointer accessible by get(), e.g. if it were created using the aliasing constructor.

examples.output:
ptr is not a valid pointer.
*ptr=7
